title: Waterside Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Waterside is a perfect Seaside cottage with a prime location just across from the beach, only 66 feet to beach access! This home has 2 king bedrooms, wrap around porches, and steps to the beach and only one block to downtown Seaside, Florida.
description_expanded: Description11 EAST RUSKIN STREET2 KINGS, 1 TWIN BUNK BED, 1 SLEEPER SOFAPrime Gulf-Front Location in the Heart of SeasidePerfectly positioned directly across from the beach and just one block from Seaside’s iconic town center, Waterside offers an unbeatable location at the corner of East Ruskin Street and Scenic Highway 30A. Situated directly opposite the East Ruskin Private Residential Beach Pavilion, this three-bedroom, three-bath home allows you to spend sun-filled days on the Gulf and retreat to shaded comfort just steps away.A Shaded Coastal Retreat Surrounded by Live OaksNestled beneath mature native live oaks, Waterside provides a peaceful and private escape from the summer sun and foot traffic of Seaside. The home is thoughtfully designed to balance beachside living with natural seclusion, offering a cool, tranquil atmosphere throughout your stay.Guests are welcomed through an expansive wraparound screened-in porch, beautifully furnished with deck chairs and a dining table for six—an ideal setting for outdoor meals, morning coffee, or relaxing evenings after a day at the beach.Open-Concept Living with Seamless Indoor-Outdoor FlowThe first floor features an inviting open living, dining, and kitchen layout, perfect for families or groups gathering together. This level includes:A king bedroomA twin bedroomTwo full bathroomsEvery room on the first floor opens directly onto a screened porch or deck through classic French doors, allowing fresh coastal breezes to flow throughout the home. The spacious galley kitchen connects easily to both the screened porch and back deck, making outdoor dining and entertaining effortless.Private Second-Floor Primary Suite SanctuaryThe entire second floor is dedicated to the king primary suite, offering a private retreat with soaring plank cathedral ceilings and exposed rafters that enhance the home’s coastal charm. This oversized suite includes:A private balcony for enjoying Gulf breezesA work table for those needing a quiet place to connectA spa-like primary bath with an oversized soaking tub, perfect for unwinding after beach daysThis serene space is so inviting, you may find it hard to leave—even with the beach just steps away.Easy Walk to Seaside Town CenterFrom the back deck, guests can access one of Seaside’s charming pedestrian footpaths, leading directly to the town center in just minutes. Boutiques, restaurants, and iconic Seaside landmarks are all within easy walking distance, making Waterside an ideal home base for exploring everything Seaside, Florida has to offer.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. 5-night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURES1,664 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceSeaside Private Residential Beach access at East Ruskin PavilionIncredible 1-minute (66-foot) walk to the beachPeacock Alley Linens – fresh, luxurious sheets and towels throughout the homePrivate driveway with parking for two vehiclesWasher and dryer for guest convenienceFull access to Seaside amenities, including three swimming pools, five clay tennis courts, three pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote featuring two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay, with starter amenities providedParking policy: One parking pass for one-bedroom cottages and two parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes. Golf carts are considered vehiclesGolf cart restrictions: Golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002094
